semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in automated equipment for semiconductor inspection, a critical part of the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: HYE Technology Co., Ltd. is a provider of self-developed automated equipment, focusing on intelligent inspection solutions for the semiconductor and optoelectronic industries. The company emphasizes customization and has a strong R&D team, serving major listed companies in Taiwan, Japan, and mainland China.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Offices in Taipei, Hsinchu, Tainan, and Kaohsiung, serving as a base for operations and customer engagement.
regional_presence.China: Offices in Suzhou and Shenzhen, targeting the local semiconductor and optoelectronic markets.
regional_presence.Japan: Serves as a key market for their automated inspection equipment.
